name: PPT 演示稿
description: 从一个主题做出一份演示稿：大纲 → 每页内容 → 排版成网页幻灯片（可打印成 PDF）→ 检查。先改大纲再出页，改哪页重跑哪步。 / Make a slide deck from a topic: outline → slide content → an HTML deck you can print to PDF → check. Fix the outline before any slide is written; change a step and re-run only that step.

topic.description: 演示主题，例如：我们团队为什么要用流程化工作 / What the talk is about

slides.description: 大约几页（含封面）/ About how many slides, cover included

theme.description: 配色：light 浅色，dark 深色 / Colors: light or dark

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 大纲
stages.description: 每页一句核心观点，按讲述顺序排好。 / One key message per slide, in speaking order.

stages.name: 每页内容
stages.description: 按大纲写每页的标题、要点和讲稿。 / Write each slide's title, bullets and speaker notes from the outline.

stages.name: 排版
stages.description: 把 slides.json 排成一个网页幻灯片和一份讲稿。浏览器里按方向键翻页，打印成 PDF 时一页一张。 / Lay out slides.json as an HTML deck plus speaker notes. Arrow keys turn pages; printing to PDF gives one slide per page.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 页数是否接近目标、每页要点是否太多太长、有没有漏写讲稿。 / Is the slide count near the target, are any slides too dense, is any speaker note missing.
